item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be generally cloudy over the region. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Saturday. Temperatures will fall appreciably with a few rain patches over the region. The associated intense northeast monsoon will affect southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cold in the morning over the region. Under the influence of a dry replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will improve over southern China midweek next week.
